dashboard.name: NutsNews Backend - Host - Systemd Service Health
dashboard.description: 24 hour dashboard for critical backend service state, process presence, restart count, failed units, and service-scoped logs. Managed from ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend.

pages.name: Service health
pages.description: Critical service state for PHP-FPM, Caddy, New Relic agents, PostgreSQL, and backend-owned services.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT latest(systemd.service.activeState), latest(systemd.service.subState) FROM Metric WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET systemd.unit LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT latest(systemd.service.activeState), latest(systemd.service.result) FROM Metric WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND systemd.service.activeState NOT IN ('active', 'activating') FACET systemd.unit LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT latest(systemd.service.restartCount) FROM Metric WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET systemd.unit TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT uniqueCount(processId), average(cpuPercent), average(memoryResidentSizeBytes) FROM ProcessSample WHERE hostname = 'backend.nutsnews.com' AND commandName IN ('php-fpm8.5', 'caddy', 'newrelic-infra', 'newrelic-daemon', 'postgres') FACET commandName LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT count(*), latest(level), latest(message) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND unit IN ('php8.5-fpm', 'caddy', 'newrelic-infra', 'newrelic-daemon', 'postgresql') FACET unit LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND unit IN ('php8.5-fpm', 'caddy', 'newrelic-infra', 'newrelic-daemon', 'postgresql') AND level IN ('error', 'critical') FACET unit TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT latest(Custom/NutsNews/job/durationMs) FROM Metric WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET job.name TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT latest(Custom/NutsNews/job/success), latest(Custom/NutsNews/job/failure), latest(status) FROM Metric WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET job.name LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT latest(Custom/NutsNews/job/active), latest(Custom/NutsNews/job/restartCount) FROM Metric WHERE service.name = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET job.name LIMIT 20 SINCE 24 hours ago

rawConfiguration.text: Use PROTECTED_BACKEND_APPLY.md for repo-managed service changes, BACKEND_HEALTH_REPORT.md for read-only status, and NEW_RELIC_OBSERVABILITY.md for New Relic verification.
